exodus.6.p1.b1.text: Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh, for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go …

exodus.6.p1.b3.text: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.

exodus.6.p1.b4.text: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.

exodus.6.p2.b5.text: I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.

exodus.6.p2.b6.text: I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. … And I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession.

exodus.6.p2.b7.text: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.

exodus.6.p3.b8.text: Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land.

exodus.6.p3.b9.text: If the Israelites will not listen to me, then why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I am unskilled in speech?

exodus.6.p3.b10.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.

exodus.6.p4.b11.text: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: …

exodus.6.p4.b12.text: And Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses.

exodus.6.p4.b13.text: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

exodus.6.p5.b14.text: I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.

exodus.6.p5.b15.text: Now on the day that the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt …

exodus.6.p5.b16.text: Since I am unskilled in speech, why would Pharaoh listen to me?
